text:
Sam T: Heads-up — we have a number of monthly-hosted API customers whose billing invoices are generated 10 days after month-end. Cut-off is this Friday EOD; we need to decide on an unbilled revenue accrual for May usage. Anyone with objections to accruing?
Ivy Billing: Can you quantify the estimated unbilled amount? Also which customers are monthly vs prepaid?
Sam T: Quick extract from billing: total estimated unbilled usage = $142,350 across 14 accounts (mostly overages + metered). Customers on prepaid/committed plans have separate schedules. This $142k is pure usage for May that hasn't been invoiced yet.
Carlos (Revenue Ops): Confirming policy: GAAP says recognize when service performed. So we should accrue for amounts earned in period even if invoiced later. Need supporting usage export and sample invoices for audit.
Ben (FP&A): Materiality check: our threshold for restatement/audit notification is $50k. This is above that. We'll need a one-page memo and CFO sign-off plus tagging audit if we post.
Eve Controller: Agree with accrual in principle. Send me the usage CSV, mapping to contract terms (price tiers) and any unapplied credits. Also confirm whether any of this will be reversed (e.g., disputed by customers).
Sam T: Uploading usage_export_May.csv and dispute_flags.csv to the thread. Flags show 2 accounts with open disputes (~$7.2k).
Ivy Billing: For those two disputed accounts, can we hold accrual to avoid booking revenue? We typically exclude amounts under active dispute until resolved (policy).
Carlos (Revenue Ops): Best practice: accrue net of probable customer credits/disputes. So accrual = 142,350 - 7,200 = 135,150. Need Controller approval.
Ben (FP&A): Draft JE for accrual (pending approvals):
```
DR 1300 Accounts Receivable        135,150
CR 4000 Revenue - Hosted API       135,150
```
And a second JE to record accrued tax/withholding if applicable — we'll calc tax separately.
Eve Controller: Fine with approach. Before posting, FP&A to prepare memo including customer list, calculation workbook, dispute rationale, and verification from Billing that no invoices will be issued pre-close that would double-count. CFO + Audit must OK.
Sam T: Billing confirms no invoices will be pushed before close. I'll lock billing runs.
Ivy Billing: Also confirm cut-off for usage attribution is 2024-05-31 23:59 UTC — use that for the usage extract.
Ben (FP&A): I'll prepare the memo and route to @CFO and auditors. Expecting to post accrual after CFO sign-off. If CFO can't sign before cut-off, we will park in a short-term liability (1100 Accrued Liabilities) pending approval to avoid misstating revenue in the closed period. Proposed interim entry if needed:
```
DR 1300 Accounts Receivable        135,150
CR 2100 Accrued Liabilities       135,150
```
(reclass once sign-off obtained).
Eve Controller: Good fallback. Also include a one-line summary for external auditors. They will want sampling of usage proofs.
revbot: Reminder: month-end cut-off is 2024-05-31 17:00 UTC for revenue recognition entries. Any late JEs require CFO tag and explanation.
Carlos (Revenue Ops): I'll prepare a 2-page support: (1) per-customer math, (2) contract pricing references, (3) sample meter exports. Targeting to upload by 09:00 tomorrow.
Ben (FP&A): Routing to finance-approvals once docs uploaded. I'll ping CFO in the morning.
Sam T: Thanks all — will stand by to post after sign-off. :thumbsup:
